title: OpenDDE Unpacked: Decoding the 'All-Atom Biomolecular Foundation Model' for Drug Discovery
angle: Break down what an 'all-atom biomolecular foundation model' means for drug discovery, how OpenDDE's architecture facilitates scalable AI-driven co-folding, and its practical implications for accelerating pharmaceutical R&D.
rationale: The release of OpenDDE is significant but dense, requiring an explanation for builders and businesses to grasp its potential and integrate it into their strategies.

source_articles.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
source_articles.excerpt: arXiv:2607.03787v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine.
